attributes.title: 2027 NASW-NY CE Conference: Social Work Forward
attributes.cme_provider: NASW New York Chapter (NYSED-approved CE provider)
attributes.summary:
The New York Chapter of NASW holds its 2027 Continuing Education Conference, "Social Work Forward: Change, Action, and Impact", on Friday, May 28, 2027, at the University at Albany. It is an in-person event only, running from morning registration to an evening reception.

Attendees can earn up to 8.0 New York State Education Department CE credits across welcome remarks, two keynotes, four breakouts and optional fireside chats. NASW-NY is a NYSED-approved provider for LMSWs, LCSWs, LMFTs, LMHCs and licensed psychologists; ASWB ACE approval is not mentioned, so licensees from other states should check with their board.

Keynote speakers, fees and the registration link were not published yet; the chapter says early-bird pricing is planned.
